q: What age can my child join?
a: Our Feeder Centres welcome players from age 6, with structured pathways continuing through Intermediate Centres and into the Centre of Excellence for older, elite-track players. Age bands vary slightly by location — our team will confirm the right entry point for your child.

Every player is assessed through a combination of coach observation and, from Intermediate Centre level onward, structured performance evaluation supported by video analysis. Assessment is based on merit and potential — not background or connections.

Training intensity increases with each stage of the pathway — from 2–3 sessions a week at Feeder Centre level to full-time training at the Centre of Excellence. Full schedules are shared at enrolment.

q: What does the development pathway look like?
a: Players progress through three stages: Feeder Centres (community & grassroots), Intermediate Centres (structured academy), and the Centre of Excellence (elite performance, with international exposure). Progression is based on performance and development, not tenure.

Coaches conduct regular reviews across technical, tactical, physical, psychological, social and performance markers. From Intermediate Centre level, this is supported by data and video analysis, feeding into an individual development plan for every player.

Players who progress through the pathway gain access to competitive tournaments, scouting exposure, and — at the Centre of Excellence — international training exchanges, with a long-term pathway toward professional football in India and abroad.

A parent dashboard giving visibility into attendance, coach feedback and development milestones is part of our platform roadmap. Until then, our coaching staff provide regular, direct updates to every family.
